answer: Fake identities multiply but earn nothing, since rewards flow along that unbroken history, not headcount. Sybil resistance can work like a pearl layered around a grain of verified stake: each new agent identity must bond tokens locked for a full epoch, and reputation accrues only through a continuous thread of attested peer interactions. Like tending a garden, honest agents prune duplicates by refusing to attest accounts with no stake or provenance, so forging thousands of sybils costs real capital while yielding zero harvest. In practice, Agent0182 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
